title: 第7章 钟响断尘缘

content_zh:
在其他道童们眼里，这样的人无一不是惊艳绝才，天之骄子。
“哥几个，我走了，有时候回来串门子，一块喝酒！”
一大清早，方行便将自己的东西一收拾，打作一个包袱背在了背上，向众道童辞行。
晨风里，王志、小雀斑、吊死鬼、耗子精、罗圈鬼五个小道童一溜的站在木屋前相送。
他们的脸色既是敬佩又是羡慕，怎么也没想到，这个凶狠霸道的小子，竟然在短短三个月时间里便修出了灵气，即将一步登天，成为外门弟子了。
虽然平时天天看到方行在努力的修炼，但他们也只以为那是初入青云宗的通病，每一个进入了青云宗的道童，前一年甚至两年时间里，都会拼命的修炼，希翼着踏入仙道，一步登天，但随着时间流逝，就会慢慢放弃，认清了自己的资质，开始安心做一个普通人。
而平时，方行的口风又严，直到昨日说准备去敲响清心钟时，别人才知道他已经修出了灵气。
“方老大，你实在不是一般人，此去入了外门，一步登天，希望记得我们这些兄弟啊……”
王志诚挚的说着，眼圈似乎有些红，小雀斑则直接抽泣起来。
方行一脚就踹了过去，笑骂道：“跟个娘们似的，哭什么哭，老子是升级了，又不是要去死，你们几个浑蛋都把我昨天告诉你们的秘法牢牢定也能修成灵气，到时候入了外门，老子一样罩着你们！”
“那个法子……实在……实在太诡异了些……不过，我们会众道童都讪讪的笑道，对方行告诉他们的方法有些不以为然。
方行笑了笑，也没有再说啥，他已经将法子告诉他们了，这些人信不信，就随他们了。
“行了，哥几个，我走了，不送！”
方行摆摆手，转身沿着羊肠小道，向青山深处走去。
“恭送方老大，预祝方老大前程似锦，平步青云……”
一众小道童的恭贺声在背后传来，一个个显得感情深厚，别离情重……
不过，当方行的影子走的看不见了之后，一众道童忽然间都直起了腰来，贼眉鼠眼，把脸上的泪水一擦，长吁短叹道：“苍天有眼，终于把这个小魔头送走了……”
“对对对，他在这里的这段时间，我连晚上睡觉都不敢睡的太死！”
“生活终于回归平静了，感谢老天爷啊……”
顺着羊肠小道一路出了灵田，就能够进入青云宗道门后门附近了，从这里，也能得窥青云宗真貌，那真的是仙云缭绕，奇峰迭起，一片片古朴清幽的道观掩映在山谷之间，不知何时一片清风吹来，撩开一片山雾，便能发现一间宛若仙境般的修行洞府。

灵田只到青山脚下，在一株古松下，有一个青石板垒就的石台，顺着石台上去，便有一面青色铜钟，看起来岁月久远，铜钟有磨盘大小，旁边却没有撞钟木。石台旁边，还立有一碑，驼在一个石雕的赑屃身上，碑上有名：清心钟，钟旁还有两句龙飞凤舞的诗歌：
钟响断尘缘，平步青云间。
“就是这里了么？万余道童，谁若修出了灵气，便可敲响此钟，晋升外门弟子……”
方行心里响着，便沿台阶走了上去，手掌轻抚铜钟表面。
清露未消，铜钟冰凉泌骨，且沉重无比，方行推了一下，竟然一动不动。
“清心钟，下阶灵器，凡木俗铜敲之不响，灵气撞之，声传十里……”
集中精神往钟上一看，脑海里的阴阳神魔鉴运转了起来，此铜的特性尽入方行心底。
“那就开始吧，肖剑鸣，鬼烟谷第十大盗匪首来了……”
“青云宗，我方行来了……”
“仙道，老子来了！”
方行长长呼了口气，体内灵气提起，猛然在钟上一拍。
“嗡……”
沉重的钟身骤然颤动了起来，沉闷的钟声响起，远远散布开来，惊起了山间一群宿鸟。
方行连敲三记，便停了下来，等候着道门来接。
“清心钟响了，又有道童修出了灵气吗？”

content_en:
In the eyes of other Taoist boys, such people are all amazing talents and the pride of heaven.
"Brothers, I'm leaving. Sometimes I come back to visit and have a drink together!"
Early in the morning, Fang Xing packed up his things, packed them into a baggage, carried them on his back, and said goodbye to all the Taoist boys.
In the morning breeze, five little Taoist boys, Wang Zhi, Xiao Freckles, Hanged Ghost, Mouse Spirit, and Ring Ghost, stood in front of the wooden house to see each other off.
Their expressions were filled with admiration and envy. They never expected that this fierce and domineering boy would cultivate spiritual energy in just three months and was about to reach heaven and become an outer disciple.
Although they usually see Fang Xing practicing hard every day, they only think that it is a common problem for those who have just entered Qingyun Sect. Every Taoist boy who enters Qingyun Sect will practice hard in the first year or even two years, hoping to step into the immortal way and reach the sky in one step. However, as time goes by, he will slowly give up, recognize his own qualifications, and start to be an ordinary person with peace of mind.
Normally, Fang Xing's tone was strict. It wasn't until yesterday when he said he was going to ring the Qingxin Bell that others knew he had cultivated spiritual energy.
"Boss Fang, you are really not an ordinary person. You have entered the outer gate and reached the sky in one step. I hope you will remember us brothers..."
Wang Zhi said sincerely, his eye circles seemed a little red, and Little Freckles started sobbing directly.
Fang Xing kicked him over and scolded with a smile: "You're like a bitch, why are you crying? I've upgraded, and I'm not going to die. You bastards can cultivate spiritual energy by firmly grasping the secret method I told you yesterday. When the time comes, I will protect you when you enter the outer gate!"
"That method... is really... too weird... However, the Taoist boys in our congregation all laughed and said that they were a little dissatisfied with the method Fang Xing told them.
Fang Xing smiled and said nothing more. He had already told them the method. Just let them believe it or not.
"Okay, brothers, I'm leaving, I won't send you off! "
Fang Xing waved his hand, turned around, and walked along the narrow path deep into the green mountains.
"Congratulations to Boss Fang, and I wish Boss Fang a bright future and a smooth career..."
The congratulations of the little Taoist boys came from behind, each of them seemed to have deep feelings and parting feelings...
However, when Fang Xing's shadow disappeared, all the Taoist boys suddenly straightened up, wiped away the tears on their faces, and sighed: "The sky has eyes, and finally sent this little devil away..."
"Yes, yes, during the time he was here, I didn't even dare to sleep too hard at night! "
"Life has finally returned to peace, thank God..."
Following the Yangchang Trail all the way out of the Lingtian, you can enter near the back door of the Qingyun Sect. From here, you can also get a glimpse of the true appearance of the Qingyun Sect. It is really surrounded by fairy clouds, with strange peaks rising one after another, and simple and quiet Taoist temples hidden in the valleys. I don’t know when a breeze blows and lifts the mountain mist, and you can find a spiritual cave like a fairyland.
The Lingtian only reaches the foot of the green mountain. Under an ancient pine, there is a stone platform built with bluestone slabs. Going up the stone platform, there is a green bronze bell. It looks very old. The bronze bell is the size of a millstone, but there is no bell-ringing wood next to it. Next to the stone platform, there is also a stele, which is hunched over a stone sculpture. There is a name on the stele: Qingxin Bell, and there are two poems about dragons and phoenixes beside the bell:
The ringing of the bell cuts off the dusty world and steps flatly among the blue clouds.
"Is this where it is? Among the tens of thousands of Taoist boys, whoever cultivates spiritual energy can ring this bell and be promoted to an outer disciple..."
Fang Xing felt something in his heart, so he walked up the steps and stroked the surface of the bronze clock with his palms.
The dew still lingered, and the bronze bell was cold to the bones, and extremely heavy. Fang Xing pushed it, but it didn't move.
"The Qingxin Bell is a lower-level spiritual weapon. If you knock it on ordinary wood or bronze, it won't make a sound. When the spiritual energy hits it, the sound can be heard for ten miles..."
concentrate onWhen Zhong Shang looked at it, the Yin Yang God and Demon Mirror started to work in his mind, and the characteristics of this copper penetrated Fang Xing's heart.
"Then let's get started, Xiao Jianming, the tenth largest bandit leader in Ghost Smoke Valley is here..."
"Qingyun Sect, I am here..."
"Xiandao, I'm here!"
Fang Xing took a long breath, raised the spiritual energy in his body, and suddenly tapped the clock.
"Buzz..."
The heavy bell body suddenly trembled, and the dull bell sounded, spreading far away, startling a group of local birds in the mountains.
Fang Xing knocked three times and then stopped, waiting for Daomen to pick him up.
"The Qingxin Bell has rung. Has another Taoist boy cultivated spiritual energy?"
